CustomField.description: Set while an AI response is being generated for this conversation, so only one message is processed at a time. Cleared by AiMessageProcessingFinalizer when the turn ends. A value in the past is treated as unlocked, so a lock can never be held forever.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Managed automatically. Blank or in the past means the conversation is free to process its next message.
CustomField.label: Processing Locked Until
